rules.name: recon-dup-07-branch-c-joins
rules.explain: SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table a ON a.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = h.business_unit AND a.trade_id = h.trade_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view sp ON sp.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND sp.business_unit = h.business_unit AND sp.security_id = h.security_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.fx_nc_factor_view fx ON fx.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND fx.business_unit = h.business_unit AND fx.trade_id = h.source_trade_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

expect.reason: the actual snapshot join is two index lookups
the pricing and traders view join for 36 rows should take seconds
the fx_nc_factor_view join for 36 rows should take seconds
